create_hanabi_env: create a Hanabi RL environment with configurable game parameters like players, colors, and ranks
run_hanabi_game_step: run a Hanabi game step by taking an action and returning observation, reward, done, and info
build_agent_interface: build an Agent class that implements reset and act methods for Hanabi game play
make_hanabi_environment: make a Hanabi environment by name such as Hanabi-Full, Hanabi-Small, or Hanabi-Very-Small
encode_hanabi_observation: encode a Hanabi observation into a vectorized representation using the canonical encoder
